reproduction.selection: Fixed stride over observed IDs, independent of outcomes; all original retail response masks.

rawFormat: Archives contain exact decompressed JSONL bytes from every measured gzip stream, without changing records or order. raw-format.json preserves original gzip and raw-byte SHA256/size. Every archive member was checked and reproduced bytes matched the isolated run.
limitations: Train contrast partitions separate augmentation families; the parent has seen original Train sources. They are not unseen-source generalization.
The candidate parser supports existing document formats and observed SKU/period/version/unit metadata. This is not unrestricted document or TAT-QA extraction.
Raw initial neural fields and all model weights remain unchanged. Decoded/final accuracy includes source constraints and observed manager replies.
The first-candidate ablation retains neural state/type/mode gating; it is not a wholly rule-only system.

Exact original retail Dev losses use five complete periods from four source families, under 35 controlled conditions. Document variants and response masks add repeated paths, not independent demand samples.
Original Dev has already been used for development. No new Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference was performed.
No new demand calibration or learned economic-value advantage is established.
